details: U.S. President Donald Trump has rejected Iran's latest peace proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable." This decision has intensified geopolitical tensions, particularly regarding the Strait of Hormuz, and led to a significant rally in oil prices due to renewed supply fears. The ongoing conflict contributes to uncertainty in global financial markets.
title: Trump Rejects Iran Peace Deal, Escalating Tensions & Raising Oil Prices

details: Bitcoin has demonstrated resilience, maintaining stability around the $81,000 level despite escalating geopolitical tensions from the US-Iran conflict. This steadiness is attributed to accelerating institutional inflows and improving macro conditions. Further positive sentiment for the cryptocurrency market comes as the U.S. Senate Banking Committee schedules a markup hearing for the crypto Clarity Act, a move aimed at establishing clear regulatory guidelines for digital assets.
title: Bitcoin Stable at $81K Amid Geopolitical Events & US Senate Advances Crypto Act
